title: How Long Can Raw Meat Sit Out?

seo.title: How Long Can Raw Meat Sit Out?
seo.meta_description: Perishable raw meat should not remain at room temperature for more than about 2 hours, or 1 hour when the temperature is above about 90°F (32°C).
seo.search_intent: Make a safe decision about “how long can raw meat sit out,” separating manageable conditions from signs that require stopping, discarding, or getting help.

excerpt: Perishable raw meat should not remain at room temperature for more than about 2 hours, or 1 hour when the temperature is above about 90°F (32°C). If the time is unknown, the safer choice is to discard it.
content_html:
Perishable raw meat should not remain at room temperature for more than about 2 hours, or 1 hour when the temperature is above about 90°F (32°C). If the time is unknown, the safer choice is to discard it.

Count total time out of refrigeration

Include shopping, transport, preparation, and time on the counter. Putting meat back in the refrigerator does not reset the safety clock.

Heat shortens the window

Cars, hot kitchens, cookouts, and sunny outdoor areas can exceed 90°F quickly. In those conditions use the one-hour limit.

Do not use smell or color to decide

Dangerous bacteria can multiply without changing appearance. Do not taste questionable raw or cooked meat to decide whether it is safe.

Cooking later does not always undo unsafe holding

Some risks are not fixed simply by cooking after prolonged warm holding. When the history exceeds safe limits, discard the food.
